description: Machine-readable selected modified database: every published trip's native ID, service dates, ordered boarding calls, permissions and clocks are in lazy details; a trip withheld as a cross-source copy is named in crossSourceCopies on the published trip that stands for it. The source search catalogues and hash-routed lookups enumerate every detail without loading a global route array. Original archives remain identified by publisher URL, exact SHA-256 and retrieval time.

crossSourceDuplicates.basis: A trip is withheld when trips published from other sources, each with at least as many calls, make at least 90% of its located calls (and at least two) in the same order at stops in the same or a neighbouring 0.0025 by 0.004 degree cell (about 280 m) and within 60 seconds in UTC on every one of its service dates, a match of fewer than nine calls counting only when the line labels agree (the same words, a shared word containing a digit, or the same digit strings); of copies with equal calls the one with a publisher road path stays, then the source that runs more of that line in the cohort, then the source listed first in the registry; frequency-based trips and services that differ in time or stops are kept, and a different vehicle making the same nine or more calls in the same minute cannot be told apart from a copy.

sources.name: JSP Skopje GTFS (Modeshift-hosted)
sources.publisher: JSP Skopje (Јавно сообраќајно претпријатие Скопје); feed hosted by Modeshift, Inc.
sources.attribution: JSP Skopje timetable, GTFS hosted by Modeshift (licence: none stated); filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Skopje city buses of JSP. The feed is on the vendor's host, not on a JSP page, and names Modeshift as feed publisher. Partial: one operator; private licensed city lines and national coaches are not in it; no national completeness claim.

sources.name: EMT Madrid (Empresa Municipal de Transportes de Madrid) city bus GTFS
sources.publisher: Empresa Municipal de Transportes de Madrid (EMT Madrid)
sources.attribution: Powered by EMT de Madrid (http://www.emtmadrid.es). EMT Madrid open data, ODC Attribution License 1.0; filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Madrid city buses run by EMT Madrid (238 routes in the archive of 2026-11-13, route_type 3), updated daily by the publisher. CRTM republishes the same routes as 'GTFS Red de EMT' (ArcGIS item 868df0e5…); that copy is not registered (duplicate). Interurban and other municipal buses are es_crtm_interurban_bus and es_crtm_urban_bus. Partial; no completeness claim.

sources.name: Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesi GTFS: city buses
sources.attribution: Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesi open data (Gaziantep Açık Veri Lisansı, https://acikveri.gaziantep.bel.tr/license); bus subset filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Gaziantep municipal GTFS (Toplu Ulaşım GTFS Verileri): scheduled bus routes (GTFS 3) only; trams T1-T3 are the transit layer's (tr_gaziantep_transit) and Gaziray suburban rail (GTFS 2) the train layer's. Partial: one municipal network; no regional or national completeness claim.

sources.name: Belgrade city public transport GTFS: buses and trolleybuses
sources.publisher: Gradska uprava grada Beograda, Sekretarijat za javni prevoz
sources.attribution: Gradska uprava grada Beograda, Sekretarijat za javni prevoz, via data.gov.rs (Serbian Open Data Licence); retrieved on the cohort's download date; bus and trolleybus subset filtered and normalized (modified) by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Belgrade city GTFS on data.gov.rs (Sekretarijat za javni prevoz): scheduled bus (GTFS 3) and trolleybus (GTFS 11, kept as trolleybus) routes; trams are the transit layer's (rs_belgrade_gsp_transit). Suburban lines are a separate dataset. Partial: one city network; no national completeness claim.

sources.name: ZET Zagreb GTFS: city buses
sources.attribution: Izvor: Zagrebački električni tramvaj d.o.o., GTFS (https://www.zet.hr/odredbe/datoteke-u-gtfs-formatu/669), date of last modification as stated in the feed; Otvorena dozvola / Open Licence - The Republic of Croatia (https://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola); data modified (bus subset filtered and normalized) by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: ZET Zagreb static GTFS: scheduled bus routes (GTFS 3) only; trams are the transit layer's (hr_zet_zagreb_transit); the funicular and cable car, if present, are not admitted here. Partial: one city network; no national completeness claim.

sources.name: ZTM Warszawa (mkuran.pl WarsawGTFS conversion): city buses
sources.publisher: Mikołaj Kuranowski (mkuran.pl), from Zarząd Transportu Miejskiego w Warszawie data
sources.attribution: ZTM Warszawa; Mikołaj Kuranowski (mkuran.pl). Zarząd Transportu Miejskiego w Warszawie timetable data under ZTM's open-access terms for timetable data; GTFS by Mikołaj Kuranowski (WarsawGTFS); the converter's OpenStreetMap-derived bus shapes are not published (schematic geometry); bus subset filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Warsaw city buses (GTFS 3) in the mkuran.pl conversion of ZTM Warszawa data; trams and metro are the transit layer's (pl_warsaw_ztm_mkuran_transit) and SKM (GTFS 2) the train layer's. Partial: one network; third-party conversion of ZTM data. ZTM's own GTFS (gtfs.ztm.waw.pl/last) resets from the cloud and is not used.

sources.name: Tper Bologna GTFS: city and suburban buses
sources.attribution: Dati: Tper S.p.A. – Rete bus Bologna in formato GTFS, CC BY 3.0 IT (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/it/), modificati: bus subset filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Tper bus network of Bologna (gommagtfsbo: urban, suburban and extra-urban buses of the Bologna basin), scheduled bus routes only. The Ferrara network (gommagtfsfe) and the Marconi Express people mover (gtfsmex) are separate feeds and not registered. Partial: one operator basin; no regional or national completeness claim.

sources.name: BKM Białystok GTFS
sources.publisher: Zarząd Białostockiej Komunikacji Miejskiej (Urząd Miejski w Białymstoku)
sources.attribution: Zarząd Białostockiej Komunikacji Miejskiej (BKM), GTFS from its open-data page (licence: none stated); bus subset filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Białystok municipal buses (BKM, 55 routes, GTFS 3) from the publisher's own open-data GTFS. Suburban private carriers outside BKM are not included. Partial: one city network; no national completeness claim.

sources.name: Galați Transurb community GTFS from OpenStreetMap (Codeberg rapiteanu/public-transport): buses and trolleybuses
sources.publisher: Viorel-Cătălin Răpițeanu (community GTFS for TRANSURB S.A. Galați)
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0); GTFS compiled by Viorel-Cătălin Răpițeanu, codeberg.org/rapiteanu/public-transport, for TRANSURB S.A. Galați; bus and trolleybus subset filtered and normalized by Euro Rail atlas.
sources.scope: Galați city buses (GTFS 3) and the trolleybus line (GTFS 11) operated by TRANSURB S.A., as compiled by a community publisher (not the operator's own channel); trams (GTFS 0) are the transit layer's. Weekday/Tuesday-Friday/weekend calendars to 31 December 2026 with holiday exceptions, as the publisher states them. Tegaltrans minibuses and the Navrom ferry are separate files, not included. Partial: one city network; no national completeness claim.
